title: feat(nsopyown): opposite-lock y-probe own incoming: reverse holds, face UNDEFINED
science: First reverse=hold anywhere in the campaign by PR number: own-incoming readout on opposite-lock y-probes gives L(A)=-e_1 (seed letter) and L(B)=+e_1, summing to zero. The hold comes entirely from the seed's own opposite lock pair being read back at A, not from any grown structure; the neighbour-lock readout on the same probes reports UNDEFINED.
